result_preview.shortDescription: Manages and retrieves service tickets, change requests, and equipment maintenance records.
result_preview.description: Exposes endpoints to retrieve, create, and update service tickets and engineering change requests tied to manufacturing equipment. Provides access to maintenance workflows, change request status tracking, and equipment diagnostics correlation for compliance and supplier management purposes.

result_preview.title: Change Request Approval Workflow API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for managing change request approvals, scheduling, and impact assessment.
result_preview.description: Exposes change request lifecycle management including approval routing, scheduling validation, and rollback planning. Enables IT governance teams to automate change controls and track approval chains across dependent service tickets and IT equipment impacts.

result_preview.title: Asset Provisioning Integration API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages equipment provisioning requests linked to service tickets and change approvals.
result_preview.description: Exposes endpoints to retrieve and manage IT equipment provisioning workflows, integrating service ticket requirements with change request approvals. Provides access to asset allocation, vendor assignments, and provisioning status updates across the ITSM ecosystem.
